items.name: Lion
items.fact: Lions live in Africa and are called the King of the Jungle

items.name: Elephant
items.fact: Elephants are the largest land animals and have amazing memory

items.name: Giraffe
items.fact: Giraffes are the tallest animals with very long necks to reach trees

items.name: Tiger
items.fact: Tigers are the biggest wild cats and have beautiful stripes

items.name: Dolphin
items.fact: Dolphins are very smart and love to play in the ocean

items.name: Penguin
items.fact: Penguins cannot fly but they are amazing swimmers

items.name: Panda
items.fact: Giant Pandas eat bamboo and are very rare and special

items.name: Kangaroo
items.fact: Kangaroos carry their babies in a special pouch on their tummy

items.name: Cheetah
items.fact: Cheetahs are the fastest animals running at 75 miles per hour

items.name: Parrot
items.fact: Parrots are colorful birds that can learn to talk like humans

items.name: Zebra
items.fact: Every zebra has a unique stripe pattern just like a fingerprint

items.name: Gorilla
items.fact: Gorillas are the largest primates and share 98% DNA with humans

items.name: Polar Bear
items.fact: Polar bears have white fur and live on the Arctic ice

items.name: Crocodile
items.fact: Crocodiles are ancient reptiles that have been on Earth for millions of years

items.name: Flamingo
items.fact: Flamingos are pink because of the shrimp and algae they eat

items.name: Hippopotamus
items.fact: Hippos spend most of the day in water to stay cool and protected

items.name: Koala
items.fact: Koalas sleep up to 22 hours a day and eat eucalyptus leaves

items.name: Chimpanzee
items.fact: Chimpanzees use tools like sticks and rocks to find and crack food

items.name: Wolf
items.fact: Wolves live in family groups called packs and howl to communicate

items.name: Shark
items.fact: Sharks have been swimming in the oceans for over 400 million years

items.name: Octopus
items.fact: Octopuses have three hearts and can change color in an instant

items.name: Eagle
items.fact: Eagles have incredibly sharp eyesight and can spot prey from miles away

items.name: Peacock
items.fact: Male peacocks have stunning blue and green feathers they fan out to impress females

items.name: Rhinoceros
items.fact: Rhinos have thick skin and a large horn made of keratin on their nose

items.name: Chameleon
items.fact: Chameleons can change their skin color to blend in with their surroundings

items.name: Whale
items.fact: Blue whales are the largest animals ever known to live on Earth

items.name: Bat
items.fact: Bats are the only mammals that can truly fly and use echolocation

items.name: Sloth
items.fact: Sloths move so slowly that algae grows on their fur

items.name: Meerkat
items.fact: Meerkats take turns standing guard to watch for danger in the desert

items.name: Porcupine
items.fact: Porcupines have sharp quills that protect them from predators

items.name: Jaguar
items.fact: Jaguars are powerful swimmers and love to hunt near rivers

items.name: Ostrich
items.fact: Ostriches are the largest birds in the world but cannot fly

items.name: Camel
items.fact: Camels store fat in their humps to survive long trips in the desert

items.name: Hedgehog
items.fact: Hedgehogs roll into a spiky ball when they feel threatened

items.name: Sea Turtle
items.fact: Sea turtles return to the same beach where they were born to lay eggs

items.name: Orca
items.fact: Orcas are also called killer whales and are highly intelligent hunters

items.name: Lemur
items.fact: Lemurs are found only on the island of Madagascar and love sunbathing

items.name: Crab
items.fact: Crabs walk sideways and have hard shells called exoskeletons

items.name: Raccoon
items.fact: Raccoons have very dexterous paws and often wash their food before eating

items.name: Fox
items.fact: Foxes are clever animals that can adapt to many different environments

items.name: Manatee
items.fact: Manatees are gentle sea mammals sometimes called sea cows

items.name: Toucan
items.fact: Toucans have enormous colorful beaks that help them reach fruit

items.name: Wombat
items.fact: Wombats produce cube-shaped droppings which is unique in the animal kingdom

items.name: Lynx
items.fact: Lynxes have thick fur and large padded paws that act like snowshoes

items.name: Manta Ray
items.fact: Manta rays glide gracefully through the ocean like underwater birds

items.name: Platypus
items.fact: The platypus is one of the few mammals that lays eggs

items.name: Snow Leopard
items.fact: Snow leopards live high in the mountains and have very long fluffy tails

items.name: Bison
items.fact: Bison are the largest land animals in North America and can sprint fast

items.name: Firefly
items.fact: Fireflies produce their own light through a chemical reaction in their bodies

items.name: Narwhal
items.fact: Narwhals have a long spiral tusk that can grow over 10 feet long

items.name: Axolotl
items.fact: Axolotls can regrow lost limbs, gills, and even parts of their hearts

items.name: Mandrill
items.fact: Mandrills are the most colorful mammals with bright red and blue faces

items.name: Stingray
items.fact: Stingrays glide along the ocean floor and have a venomous tail spine

items.name: Capybara
items.fact: Capybaras are the world's largest rodents and love to swim

items.name: Caracal
items.fact: Caracals have tall pointed ears with black tufts on the tips

items.name: Pangolin
items.fact: Pangolins are covered in overlapping scales and roll into a ball for defense

items.name: Moose
items.fact: Moose are the largest members of the deer family with massive antlers

items.name: Puffin
items.fact: Puffins can flap their wings up to 400 times per minute to fly

items.name: Armadillo
items.fact: Armadillos have a hard bony shell and can roll into a protective ball

items.name: Tasmanian Devil
items.fact: Tasmanian Devils have one of the strongest bites of any mammal their size

items.name: Quokka
items.fact: Quokkas are small marsupials known as the happiest animals in the world

items.name: Binturong
items.fact: Binturongs smell like popcorn due to a chemical they produce

items.name: Sunfish
items.fact: The ocean sunfish is the world's heaviest bony fish, weighing over a ton

items.name: Albatross
items.fact: Albatrosses can glide for thousands of miles without flapping their wings

items.name: Anaconda
items.fact: Anacondas are the world's heaviest snakes and live in South American swamps

items.name: Frog
items.fact: Frogs absorb water through their skin instead of drinking it

items.name: Jellyfish
items.fact: Jellyfish have no brain, heart, or bones but have survived millions of years

items.name: Hummingbird
items.fact: Hummingbirds can flap their wings up to 80 times per second

items.name: Mongoose
items.fact: Mongooses are famous for being immune to snake venom

items.name: Bonobo
items.fact: Bonobos are peaceful primates that share nearly all their DNA with humans

items.name: Starfish
items.fact: Starfish can regrow lost arms and have no brain or blood

items.name: Harpy Eagle
items.fact: Harpy eagles are the most powerful eagles with talons the size of bear claws

items.name: Kiwi Bird
items.fact: The kiwi bird is the only bird with nostrils at the tip of its beak

items.name: Coyote
items.fact: Coyotes are adaptable wild dogs found across North America

items.name: Lobster
items.fact: Lobsters can live over 100 years and do not naturally age biologically

items.name: Dung Beetle
items.fact: Dung beetles navigate using the Milky Way and can roll balls 10 times heavier than themselves

items.name: Honey Badger
items.fact: Honey badgers are fearless and can fight off animals much larger than themselves

items.name: Flying Squirrel
items.fact: Flying squirrels glide through the air using flaps of skin between their legs

items.name: Electric Eel
items.fact: Electric eels can generate up to 600 volts of electricity

items.name: Tapir
items.fact: Tapirs have a flexible snout they use to grab leaves and branches

items.name: Ibis
items.fact: The sacred ibis was worshipped in ancient Egypt as a symbol of wisdom

items.name: Walrus
items.fact: Walruses use their tusks to pull themselves up onto ice floes

items.name: Mantis Shrimp
items.fact: Mantis shrimp can punch with the force of a bullet and see 16 types of color

items.name: Okapi
items.fact: Okapis look like zebra-giraffe hybrids and are the giraffe's only living relative

items.name: Proboscis Monkey
items.fact: Male proboscis monkeys have enormous noses that help attract mates

items.name: Surinam Toad
items.fact: Surinam toads carry eggs embedded in the skin of their back

items.name: Aye-Aye
items.fact: Aye-ayes are nocturnal primates with an extremely long thin middle finger to find grubs

items.name: Saiga Antelope
items.fact: Saiga antelopes have unusual bulbous noses that filter and warm cold air

items.name: Blobfish
items.fact: Blobfish look squishy at the surface but are perfectly shaped for deep-sea pressure

items.name: Secretary Bird
items.fact: Secretary birds are tall eagles that hunt by stomping on snakes with their powerful feet

items.name: Gharial
items.fact: Gharials have long narrow snouts lined with over 100 teeth for catching fish

items.name: Tardigrade
items.fact: Tardigrades are microscopic animals that can survive in outer space

items.name: Shoebill
items.fact: Shoebills have enormous shoe-shaped bills and stare without blinking

items.name: Komodo Dragon
items.fact: Komodo dragons are the world's largest lizards and can run at 12 mph

items.name: Vampire Bat
items.fact: Vampire bats are the only mammals that feed entirely on blood

items.name: African Wild Dog
items.fact: African wild dogs have a nearly 80% hunting success rate, the highest of any predator

items.name: Blue-Ringed Octopus
items.fact: The tiny blue-ringed octopus carries enough venom to kill 26 adult humans

items.name: Wolverine
items.fact: Wolverines are pound-for-pound one of the most ferocious animals in the wild

items.name: Musk Ox
items.fact: Musk oxen have shaggy coats so thick they can survive Arctic temperatures of minus 40 degrees

items.name: Aardvark
items.fact: Aardvarks have sticky tongues and eat thousands of termites and ants each night
